d:
SIR (Special Intensive Revision) ke mudde par jharkhand vidhanasbha men vishesh satr bulaya gaya. JMM ki or se kaha gaya ki SIR par sadan bulane vala jharkhand desh ka pahla rajy hai. parti ne spasht kiya ki vah SIR ki prakriya par saval utha rahi hai. aakhir JMM ne SIR ko lekar kya kuchh kaha aur chunav aayog ki prakriya par kya aapattiyan jataeen? dekhie pura bayana.
